generations.prompt:
Character design preproduction for Soulmonsters. Create a wide white sheet with FIVE BLACK SOLID SILHOUETTES, one full-body silhouette per character, clean white negative spaces at separated limbs, no interior linework or colors. Small neat names under each: Iara, Nilo, Dora, Cauê, Celina. Feet on common baseline, heights genuinely varied. Reference images supply ONLY the slender delicate manga proportion language, not outfits or hair to copy. No chibi, no oversized shoes, no weapons.
Design them as a memorable ensemble of Brazilian kite tamers, each with a different occupation, posture and 2-3 strong functional shape signals. Avoid the repeated pointed coats/capes/wing collars from our previous attempt.
Left IARA: athletic 17 year old girl, height 164cm, huge single braided side LOOP with clear open center, short round-shouldered cropped rescue jacket, fitted shorts and practical climbing shoes; one bent knee, torso leaning forward in focused kite-line untangling stance, one arm extended holding taut line and the other near waist reel. Asymmetrical circular hair versus compact sporty silhouette.
NILO: lanky 15 year old boy 171cm, broad flattened swept forelock (not high spikes), fitted short courier vest, high-waisted narrow ankle trousers, one large rectangular folded kite delivery satchel strapped diagonally against his back with visible straps, frame peeks ABOVE ONE shoulder only; tiptoe leaning walking pose looking behind. Unmistakable narrow diagonal silhouette.
DORA: 22 year old short stocky sturdy woman 151cm, short blunt plum bob hair, square puffed short sleeve workshirt, cropped broad barrel trousers and short square work apron; holds ONE chunky wooden circular line reel horizontally in both hands at waist, elbows splayed. Wide compact square body, strong legs, confident planted stance. Reel has a through axle.
CAUÊ: tall slender dark-skinned 19 year old young man 187cm, narrow cropped curly hair with a square upright tuft, high-collar short sleeveless survey vest, very long narrow pants, quietly upright slight side profile with one leg relaxed; holds a single long lightweight fork-shaped wind-measuring rod grounded near foot and extending just above head, two short cloth wind ribbons fixed at fork. Clear gap rod/body. No cape, no trench coat.
CELINA: mature 48 year old short broad woman 155cm, low wide horizontal hair bun (not a small round bun), long rolled sleeves under a rounded short seamstress smock with broad curved hem to mid-thigh, slim cropped pants, normal slippers, bent slightly forward laughing with one hand gesturing and the other holding a large oval BAMBOO KITE FRAME beside her hip, oval open center distinct from Iara's small braidloop. No granny caricature, believable middle age. Silhouette reads pear shaped.
All silhouettes flat pure black and crisp. No black rectangles behind them. Generous spacing, no overlap, no scenery, no large props concealing torsos. This is silhouette exploration, not final colored art.

Create a refined original Soulmonsters NPC ensemble concept sheet, FIVE full-body characters in a SINGLE horizontal row, white background, generous margins and feet completely visible. Small handwritten names below each only: Iara, Nilo, Dora, Cauê, Celina. Landscape wide sheet.
REFERENCE ROLES: IMAGE 1 is the PRIMARY approved ART STYLE (Soulmonsters announcer). Match its delicate thin dark line, small simple nose/mouth, expressive OVAL anime eyes, gentle chin, long clean limbs, softly flat colors and just one small economical cel-shadow tone. IMAGE 2 is the creator's own Kael manga art; use its clean face construction and hand-drawn hair masses, not its clothing or hairstyle. IMAGE 3 provides DISTINCT silhouette/body/pose CONSTRUCTION for the ensemble, not a rendered style. Translate those shapes into the exact thin-line 2D manga language of image1. Mature characters must still look that age. Avoid big round cartoon heads, chibi, thick sticker outlines, gradients, texture, painted or 3D shading. Do not copy the announcer feather collar onto anyone.
Maintain these five different physical identities, personalities and occupations; their clothes visibly belong to a living-paper/kite game through construction and functional equipment, not fantasy weapons or badges everywhere. Keep forms simple enough to animate. Common baseline; naturally different head heights. THREE main color masses per person, few larger shapes, no accessory clutter.
IARA, 17, dark brown skin, athletic girl. Black braided hair gathered in a single LARGE LOOP beside head, but CORRECT the silhouette ref: braid loop is tied at base and naturally hangs toward her shoulder, NOT floating sideways or an enormous magical coiled tail. Distinct attentive face, strong angled brows and almond-oval brown eyes, small confident closed smile. Sage green short round-shouldered rescue jacket over cream shirt, charcoal fitted shorts, sage normal ankle climbing shoes. Functional rounded padded shoulder panels with a single leaf-shaped overlapping seam (no giant leaf collar), rescue-line belt with ONE wood reel on hip. Left arm extended controlling taut kite line, other hand near reel; braced bent-knee stance. She untangles stranded kites but is afraid to admit heights make her nervous: determined face not smug.
NILO, 15, warm medium tan skin, very lanky, brown FLAT windswept broad forelock and short sides, narrow sleepy oval eyes that contrast his restless leaning tiptoe motion. Short mustard courier vest with one rust inner fold, cream T shirt, navy narrow high-waisted ankle pants. ONE long rectangular folded-kite delivery case fixed snugly diagonally against his back, real two-point shoulder strap and simple diamond-fold lid, end peeks above ONE shoulder. Ordinary canvas shoes. Looking back mid-step with raised questioning eyebrow and sheepish tiny smile. No cape, no long coat. He is a speedy courier who always has to check the address twice.
DORA, 22, short broad sturdy woman, light brown skin and a FEW freckles, smooth blunt PLUM bob with one orange square hairclip, low broad brows, expressive oval brown eyes, wide enthusiastic smile; adult woman, not a child. CORAL workshirt with squared short puff sleeves, CREAM short rectangle apron tied visibly at waist, graphite broad barrel-shaped cropped trousers. Holds ONE wooden line reel horizontally at waist with both hands genuinely gripping opposite ends of the THROUGH AXLE, elbow gaps visible. Wood reel is human-scale about 35cm, NOT barrel bigger than body. Two simple sun-ray wedge seams on cuff hint at partner Raio de sol. Warm strong planted stance, normal practical shoes. Passionate precision craftswoman with unexpectedly meticulous tiny knots.
CAUÊ, 19, genuinely TALLEST at 187cm, slender dark brown skin, cropped tightly curly hair with a squared top tuft, long narrow gentle face, calm half-lidded oval eyes, small shy smile. OLIVE short sleeveless wind-surveyor vest high asymmetric collar with one large folded-paper pleat, ochre shirt, beige very long slim trousers, normal olive shoes. One hand in pocket, other holds a slender bamboo Y-FORK wind gauge rooted on the ground: exactly TWO short leaflike cloth ribbons tied visibly at fork above shoulder, scientific wind-reading tool NOT mage staff or battle spear. Arms/rod clear negative space. Quiet upright stance one relaxed knee; looks to side listening to wind. No tails, no trench coat, no large feathers.
CELINA, 48, SHORT BROAD sturdy woman, light brown skin, slate-grey hair in a WIDE LOW HORIZONTAL bun with two soft temple locks; visible middle-age eyes, subtle smile lines, softened jaw, knowing laughing expression, not a young mother, not elderly caricature. TERRACOTTA rolled sleeves under SLATE-BLUE round-cut seamstress smock with large CREAM curved facing on one side and curved hem mid-thigh, narrow dark cropped pants, simple normal slippers. Leaning slightly forward warmly explaining a trick with right hand, holds a SINGLE OVAL bamboo kite frame at left side, loop frame supported by hand with visible tied bamboo ribs, not a tennis racket. One broad pocket contains two short sticks, not weapon blades. She repairs everyone else's kites but loves competitive duels. Few simple curved fabric seams suggest the arc of Raio de sol, no shiny gold trim.
Do not add monsters, giant scenery, secondary views, expressions floating around, logos or watermark. All five must feel like the SAME authorial manga as reference1, with genuinely DIFFERENT face shapes, head/body heights, builds, garments and attitudes. Characters occupy most of sheet height but heads are not artificially aligned. Full bodies only.

review.performed: Visual inspection of both full-size generated sheets against approved references.
strengths: Different body masses, poses and relative head heights
Functional reel axle, kite frame ribs and delivery-case strap
Thin manga lines, restrained cel shadows and white background
limitations: Concept art only: no actual game-scale sprite or animation validation performed
Iara's braid remains quite exaggerated; review this identity cue with the user
Generated silhouettes include some internal white construction lines; not a pure solid-black pixel test
